name: Ammihud
overview: The name Ammihud appears in the Old Testament as a patriarchal figure linked to several tribal leaders, highlighting his role in Israel's tribal organization. He is identified as the father of Elishama, who served as captain of the Ephraimites, as well as the father of Shemuel of Simeon and Pedahel of Naphtali, indicating Ammihud's descendants held significant leadership positions across multiple tribes. These references in Numbers emphasize Ammihud's place within the genealogical and administrative structure God established for His people during their wilderness journey.
